title: Command workbench
idea: Command workbench: A search-driven command field leads contextual results and preview
audience: People who need to run command within a desktop surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic command layout through its run command priority and explicit commitment contract: Explicit confirmation precedes destructive commands
navigation: Command workbench keeps the current run command context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A search-driven command field leads contextual results and preview
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to run command; experienced users repeat named operations

imagery.role: Support the actual run command context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep command history readable at small window heights
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the command workbench structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no run command content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Explicit confirmation precedes destructive commands
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized run command content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active run command context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
